# Dario Safaric

**Headline:** Founder of NEXT Pharma Summit 
- NEXT CX & AI 25’ - November 18&19 in Vienna
- NEXT 26’ - May 19&20 in Dubrovnik
**Current role:** Chairman
**Seniority:** President/Vice President, General Management
**Location:** Croatia
**Experience:** 17 years
**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/dariosafaric · 11,295 followers
**Description:** 🚀 Moving the needle in Pharma through NEXT Pharma events! I’m passionate about driving change in the pharmaceutical industry by organizing cross-functional events that bring together leaders from commercial, medical, digital, marketing, tech, and beyond. Under the NEXT Pharma brand, we create spaces for bold ideas, collaboration, and innovation. Pharma is one of the greatest industries, and our mission is to provoke new thinking and explore fresh directions to make it even more progressive. The future of healthcare depends on those willing to challenge the status quo—and I’m here to make that happen. Let’s connect and shape what’s next! 🚀

## Experience
- **Chairman** at NEXT Pharma Summit (Jun 2018 to present)
- **VP of Sales and Marketing** at Media-soft d.o.o. (Aug 2009 to Jul 2025)
- **Country Manager** at Mediasoft UK (Oct 2009 to Feb 2015)
- **Co-Founder and Chief Creative Officer** at Geno Kids (Mar 2021 to Apr 2023)
- **VP of Marketing** at StoryPad (Jan 2015 to Jun 2018)

## Education
